title: Intermix
summary: INTERMIX', verb transitive [inter and mix.] To mix together; to put some things with others; to intermingle. In yonder-spring of roses, intermix'd With myrtle, find what to redress 'till noon. INTERMI

inlines.v: INTERMIX', verb transitive [inter and mix.] To mix together; to put some things with others; to intermingle. In yonder-spring of roses, intermix'd With myrtle, find what to redress 'till noon. INTERMIX', verb intransitive To be mixed together; to be intermingled.
